invariants.rationale: The method always returns the 'records' list, which is explicitly allocated and thus not null.
The method accesses clusteringGroup.getSlices(), so clusteringGroup must not be null prior to method execution and at this point.
instantTime is passed to other methods and used as a parameter, so it must not be null for correct operation.
